## About
If you have never been to Side Pockets, you might be surprised. We put a lot of thought into what a sports bar and restaurant should be, and we wanted it to feel like an unexpected find the first time and a favorite spot every time after.
It's a bar, a restaurant and a place to play, all under one roof. There are pool tables, electronic darts, Golden Tee Golf and a TouchTunes jukebox, plus big screens showing sports all day long. Our kitchen handles lunch, dinner and late night snacks, with carry out and online ordering through Chow Now.
A few of our team members have been hanging around for a pretty long time, because we're that kind of place. Guests have given us a 4.2 rating from 578 Google reviews, and we'd love to see you here.

## Services
- Pool tables: 20 pool tables, including Diamond Pro Am tables.
- Free pool with lunch: Come in for lunch on a weekday and your pool time is free.
- Pool leagues: League play mostly through APA, with divisions from the 3&2 pool league and the BCA as well.
- Happy hours: Stop by for KC's Longest Happy Hour, or come later for our Late Night Happy Hour.
- Party and banquet area: A large party and banquet area for your next party or banquet. Contact us to book it.
- Carry out: Carry out is available from our menu.

## FAQ
Q: Can I get food late?
A: Yes. Our full service kitchen is open for lunch, dinner and late night snacks.

Q: What forms of payment do you take?
A: We accept Visa, MasterCard, Discover and American Express. Sorry, no checks.

Q: Is gratuity added for big groups?
A: Yes. An 18% gratuity is added to parties of 8 or more.

Q: When can I join a pool league?
A: It might be possible to join a team now, but new sessions usually start around the first of the year. Contact us or reach out to the league organizers for details.

Q: Is it a good spot for kids?
A: One reviewer called it kid friendly earlier in the evening, and suggested checking for league night before you go.
